title: A supplied geometric generic cover spreads on an etale model before incidences are spread
statement: Let f:X\to S be finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], with S irreducible. Fix a field L and a finite etale morphism y_eta:Spec L\to Spec kappa(eta_S) [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let I be finite and A_i a closed cover of G=X_eta_S times_{kappa(eta_S)} Spec L [def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-pc-fibre-product]. Assume each A_i has irreducible nonempty inverse image under every field base change of G over L [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. There exist a scheme T, an etale map g:T\to S, a generic point eta_T of T, and closed subsets C_i of P=X times_S T such that g(eta_T)=eta_S, the C_i cover P, and for every t in T and every field-valued z:Spec E\to Spec kappa(t), the inverse image of C_i in P_t times_{kappa(t)} Spec E is irreducible nonempty. For every i,j with A_i intersect A_j nonempty, C_i intersect C_j meets the fibre over eta_T. No persistence of nongeneric intersections is asserted.

proof.text: If I is empty, apply the already proved model-data theorem and discharge the geometric fibre and incidence assertions by elimination of an empty index. This requires no field model construction or irreducibility shrinking.

If I is nonempty, obtain T, g, eta, a from the compatible etale generic-fibre model. Define C_i = closure(a(A_i)). The embedding closure formula proves a inverse image of C_i equals A_i. The cover of A implies the C_i cover the fibre over eta. The supplied field-base-change isomorphisms transport the geometric irreducibility of A_i to every geometric generic trace of C_i.

Apply closed-family geometric irreducibility shrinking to C_i. Apply the already proved closed-cover shrinking theorem to the finite closed union of the C_i and the empty subset; their union covers the generic fibre. Intersect the two opens. Restrict g to this open, pull back the C_i along the canonical pullback.map r, and retain the generic point in this open.

The inverse images along r are closed and cover by the closed-cover open. The restricted generic point is generic by specialization in a subtype. A proved private helper pastes the fibre square of any pullback with any residue-field test square to give an isomorphism of geometric fibres; use it to transport the geometric irreducibility on the chosen open. For x in A_i intersect A_j, a(x) lies in the generic fibre. The range formula for pullback.map supplies b over a(x). Closure membership gives both closed-subset memberships, and commutativity and subtype injectivity prove its base point is eta in the restricted open.

proof_origin.note: M3: compatible generic fibre model plus independent closed-family irreducibility shrinking. Closures, their exact generic traces, covering restriction, fibre transport and generic incidences are proved in Lean. No arbitrary-cover refinement.
